front: What are the five health-related components of physical fitness?
back: Cardiorespiratory endurance, muscular strength, muscular endurance, flexibility, and body composition.

front: What does the FITT-VP exercise prescription framework represent?
back: Frequency, Intensity, Time (duration), Type (mode), Volume (total work), and Progression (systematic overload over time).

front: How is target heart rate zone estimated using the Karvonen formula (Heart Rate Reserve)?
back: Target HR = ((Max HR − Resting HR) × % Intensity) + Resting HR, where Max HR is approximately 220 − Age.
